about: Every file in src/ that sends an email to a person (a letter role from src/lib/email/letter.ts). Each letter is rendered with fixture data by tests/unit/email/every-letter-greets.test.ts; scripts/guards/every-letter-greets.mjs fails the build when a file sends to a person and is not listed here. CONTROLLER 08:58 gap 3, 31 October 2026.

notLetters.src/lib/campaigner/sink.ts: an organiser's own campaign, in the organiser's words and signed by the organiser's identity line; signing it 'The EventLinqs team' would put our name on their message
notLetters.src/lib/listings/organiser-live-notice.t: a founder-voice message in Lawal's own format (the PM's ruling of 8 November 2026, 15:00, item 3): it greets 'Hi <first name>,' and signs 'Kind regards, Lawal Adams, Founder, EventLinqs', not 'The EventLinqs team', and every one of its words is judged before any send by the gateway's own checks (src/lib/outreach/voice-gate.ts), tested in tests/unit/listings/organiser-live-notice.test.ts
notLetters.src/lib/listings/sell-through-report.ts: a founder-voice message in Lawal's own format (his ruling of 8 November 2026, 16:13, build 3, the sell-through report): it greets 'Hi <first name>,' and signs 'Kind regards, Lawal Adams, Founder, EventLinqs' with the opt out, not 'The EventLinqs team', and every one of its words is judged by the gateway's own checks (src/lib/outreach/voice-gate.ts) before any send, in tests/unit/listings/sell-through-report.test.ts
